notes: Floors, not pins. Before any store release, re-check store rules on the web and record the result in the project's app-sync/baseline.json.

android.rule: Google Play: new apps and updates must target API 36 (Android 16) since 2026-08-31. Expect API 37 around August 2027.

ios.rule: App Store Connect: uploads must be built with Xcode 26 / iOS 26 SDK since 2026-04-28.

ota.note: Ionic Appflow is being discontinued in 2026; do not build new release flows on it.
